title: Re-authored routes of phase 3 (Claude continuation, 2026-11-05)
description: Routing of two blocked cards that the user's decision of 2026-11-05 (Claude authors, Claude Sonnet reviews) sends to a Claude re-author (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human): gh.sciencecorp/galago-tools re-selects the pack's OT-2 tool, whose run has a stop with a status read-back, instead of the SpectraMax plate reader, which has no abort; gh.moler-group/scanning-squid leaves the recon route for the repository's primary device, the scanning SQUID microscope, under the class its documentation names. Each entry replaces the repository's earlier entry (labs.json, helper-wave-1-routing.json; originals kept in the batch). Nothing here changes source pins, package status, signatures or publication.

overrides.justification: Re-author (claude-opus-5-5): the primary device is the scanning SQUID microscope (microscope.rst:4, SusceptometerMicroscope); a direct Driver serves its Attocube stepping with the stop-and-ground stop (atto.py:143-152).
Re-author (claude-opus-5-5): the SpectraMax has no abort; the pack's OT-2 tool stops a run (driver.py:167-197) and reads its status (199-214); a direct Driver at R2 with a bounded transport.
